description: This file defines a Java Swing UI component named WarningPanel that displays warning and error messages related to firmware status and connection issues. It includes UI elements like labels, buttons, and a timer for blinking indicators, as well as event listeners reacting to messages central to the application.

classes.name: WarningPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel for displaying warning/error messages with blinking alert for fatal errors.

methods.name: WarningPanel
methods.description: Constructor setting up the UI elements and message listener.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the label and disables the reset button.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel component containing the warning UI.
